protocol.length: at most 512 observations; one seeded uniformly placed window per longer series, whole series otherwise
protocol.folds: same four-fold fresh-query protocol, matched candidates, and real-only calibration as the cross-frequency benchmark
protocol.hourly: not rerun; Monash traffic_hourly results are in feature_coverage_hourly_composition and feature_coverage_traffic_composition
protocol.limits: one panel per frequency; aligned calendars for hospital and traffic_weekly; real roles overlap across folds; no confidence intervals; forecasting utility not measured

source.description: 518 yearly tourism demand series (Athanasopoulos et al., 2011)
427 quarterly tourism demand series (Athanasopoulos et al., 2011)
767 monthly hospital patient-count series, 84 observations each (Hyndman, expsmooth)
862 weekly San Francisco freeway occupancy series, 104 observations each (Lai et al., 2017)
3010 daily Australian weather series: rain, minimum and maximum temperature, solar radiation (Sparks et al., bomrang)
